measure.official_title: City of Cherry Hills Village Ballot Question 2C

entries.neutral_title: Amends the city home rule charter to state that planning, zoning, density and land development are regulated only under the charter and city ordinances, irrespective of state mandates

evidence.section: City of Cherry Hills Village Ballot Question 2C — ballot question text
evidence.quote: Shall Article 1 of the City of Cherry Hills Village Home Rule Charter, entitled "General Provisions," be amended to add a new Section 1.6 entitled "Home Rule Authority to Regulate the Use of Land", as set forth below? 1.6. Home Rule Authority to Regulate the Use of Land. The authority to plan for, zone, and regulate density, the uses of land, the location and character of structures, and the development of real property within the City are matters of local and municipal concern vested in the City by the Colorado Constitution and this Charter, and such matters shall be regulated only in accordance with this Charter and ordinances enacted pursuant to this Charter. The City shall not be required to adopt or implement laws, standards, approval processes, assessments, plans, or reports on such matters other than as may be enacted by the City Council pursuant to Section 3.1 of this Charter or the voters of the City pursuant to Section 13.11 of this Charter, irrespective of state mandates to do so.

verification.against: Arapahoe County 2026 General Election Sample Ballot (English), Arapahoe County Clerk and Recorder

limitations: No TABOR notice applies (not a tax/debt issue). Question text also matches the City's Election Information page, which states Council referred it by Ordinance 8, Series 2026 on August 18, 2026.
Ordinance 8, Series 2026 PDF was downloaded but has no extractable text (image-only scan); its content was not read, so it is not cited as the resolution source.

Classified land_use because it concerns authority over zoning, density and land use in relation to state mandates; the legal effect on state housing/land-use laws is not assessed here. Inclusion confirmed by owner decision (2026-09-26).
